source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Describe the conditions leading to the failed audit in detail. 
3. Identify the specific areas which contributed to the failure. 
4. List the Standards, Regulations, or Guidelines not met.
5. Document personnel involved in the audit process.
6. Record the corrective actions recommended by the audit.
7. Include photographic evidence if available.
8. Note the timeframe given to rectify the issues.
9. Record any correspondence with regulatory bodies or auditors.
10. Make sure to document any follow-up actions taken after the audit.
